scope_notes: Covers the vLLM v0.19.1 PUBLIC config surface a benchmark caller can plausibly touch.

STRUCTURAL DELTA vs v0.7.3: the flat vllm/config.py (~3490 LOC) is GONE. v0.19.1 ships a SUBPACKAGE vllm/config/* with one module per concern (model.py, cache.py, parallel.py, scheduler.py, speculative.py, compilation.py, etc.). Qualnames are e.g. vllm.config.model.ModelConfig but the public re-export vllm.config.ModelConfig still resolves (config/__init__.py).

Config classes are now @config-decorated pydantic dataclasses (vllm.config.utils.config wraps pydantic.dataclasses.dataclass), several with Field(ge=, gt=, le=) declarative constraints captured inline in default_expr. v0.7.3 mixed plain classes / msgspec / pydantic BaseModel.
EngineArgs is a THIN OVERLAY: field defaults reference subconfig class attributes; the authoritative literal default lives in the subconfig field (subconfigs namespace).
Fields with citation file/line use 1-based line numbers as displayed by Read tool against /tmp/trial_vllm_v0_19_1_venv/src/vllm/.

type_annotation is the verbatim source annotation string (ast.unparse); default_expr is the verbatim RHS. Field(...) / get_field(...) / field(...) wrappers are preserved so declarative constraints (ge/gt/le) and init=False markers stay visible.
engine_envs enumerates every key in vllm.envs.environment_variables (238 keys at v0.19.1, up from 84 at v0.7.3). Runtime control surface outside the dataclass tree; the baseline misses it entirely.
InitVar fields on ModelConfig (limit_mm_per_prompt, mm_* etc.) are constructor-only shims that forward into the nested MultiModalConfig; flagged via type_annotation starting with InitVar[.

engine_params._note: v0.19.1 EngineArgs is a @dataclass (line 373) that acts as a THIN OVERLAY over the vllm.config.* subpackage. Most field DEFAULTS are class-attribute references to a subconfig (e.g. `model: str = ModelConfig.model`) or `get_field(SubConfig, 'name')` for mutable defaults; a handful are literal (e.g. `enable_lora: bool = False`, `block_size=None`). The authoritative literal default therefore lives in the referenced subconfig field, captured in the `subconfigs` namespace. `default_expr` is the verbatim RHS expression as written in EngineArgs. 185 fields total (v0.7.3 had 103). __post_init__ (line 640) coerces dict->dataclass for compilation_config/attention_config/kernel_config/eplb_config/weight_transfer_config and loads plugins.

sampling_params._note: msgspec.Struct (PydanticMsgspecMixin + msgspec.Struct, line 156-162), NOT a dataclass. Validation in __post_init__ (line 373) -> _verify_args (line 427) -> _verify_greedy_sampling (line 521). v0.19 DELTAS vs v0.7.3: top_k default 0 (was -1); new fields flat_logprobs, skip_clone, extra_args, thinking_token_budget, repetition_detection (nested RepetitionDetectionParams), skip_reading_prefix_cache, _bad_words_token_ids, _eos_token_id; `structured_outputs` replaces `guided_decoding`; `best_of`/`_real_n` REMOVED (beam/best_of split out); n now capped by envs.VLLM_MAX_N_SEQUENCES (default 16384).

beam_search_params._note: msgspec.Struct, line 909. Mode-exclusive with SamplingParams. Identical 6-field shape to v0.7.3.

pooling_params._note: @dataclass, line 37. GREW substantially from v0.7.3 (1 placeholder field -> 10 fields). Out of LLEM text-gen scope but enumerated. Validation in verify/_set_default_parameters/_verify_valid_parameters.

structured_outputs_params._note: RENAMED from GuidedDecodingParams (v0.7.3). @dataclass, line 37. __post_init__ (line 55) enforces exactly-one-constraint (count>1 -> error; count<1 -> error - NEW vs v0.7.3 which only rejected >1). New field `structural_tag` joins the mutually-exclusive set; new `disable_additional_properties`, `structural_tag`.

repetition_detection_params._note: NEW in v0.19.1 (no v0.7.3 equivalent). @dataclass line 110. Nested under SamplingParams.repetition_detection. __post_init__ line 128 validates pattern sizes and min_count>=2.

engine_envs._note: Every key in vllm.envs.environment_variables (238 at v0.19.1 vs 84 at v0.7.3, ~2.8x growth). Each entry is a lambda evaluated lazily on attribute access (envs.VLLM_FOO re-reads os.environ). Behaviour summaries omitted at this scan for the bulk (CI-affordability); high-leverage entries are annotated in delta.md / version_delta.md. The lambda key is authoritative over the TYPE_CHECKING stub. RUNTIME control surface, NOT in baseline coverage.
engine_envs._access_pattern: import vllm.envs as envs; envs.VLLM_USE_V1 (triggers __getattr__ -> environment_variables[name]())
